shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular tan stone slab
profile head with prominent eye and beak/nose
wing or feather rendered as rows of parallel incised lines
arm with hand/forelimb shown against the body
horizontal band or register dividing the field
small disc/round element in the field
justification: Both are weathered, tan, shallow-relief stone panels featuring a profile head, arm/hand, and feather-like rows of parallel incised lines, and both show a horizontal dividing band, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is dominated by one large, anatomically modelled winged human figure filling the whole field, while B stacks several small, flat, schematic animal figures in tiers with a decorative top register, so composition and carving manner differ sharply.
